<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Re-examine initial vs current states carefully
init_ascii = history[0].frame.ascii.split('\n')
cur_ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_p_symbol(ascii_lines, si):
    inner_col = 15 + si * 7
    return tuple(ascii_lines[51+dr][inner_col:inner_col+5] for dr in range(1, 6))

def get_p_cells(ascii_lines):
    centers = [(7, 25), (7, 48), (16, 25), (16, 48), (25, 25), (25, 48)]
    cells = {}
    for idx, (cr, cc) in enumerate(centers):
        row, col = idx // 2, idx % 2
        pat = tuple(ascii_lines[cr+dr][cc-2:cc+3] for dr in range(-2, 3))
        cells[(row, col)] = pat
    return cells

p_cells = get_p_cells(cur_ascii)

print("INITIAL vs CURRENT P symbols:")
for si in range(5):
    init_s = get_p_symbol(init_ascii, si)
    cur_s = get_p_symbol(cur_ascii, si)
    changed = "CHANGED" if init_s != cur_s else "same"
    print(f"  P{si}: {changed}")
    if init_s != cur_s:
        print(f"    init: {init_s}")
        print(f"    cur:  {cur_s}")

# Check which initial symbols matched which cells
print("\nINITIAL P symbol -> P cell matches:")
for si in range(5):
    psym = get_p_symbol(init_ascii, si)
    for (r,c), pcell in p_cells.items():
        if psym == pcell:
            print(f"  P{si} = P-cell ({r},{c})")

# Check current matches
print("\nCURRENT P symbol -> P cell matches:")
for si in range(5):
    psym = get_p_symbol(cur_ascii, si)
    for (r,c), pcell in p_cells.items():
        if psym == pcell:
            print(f"  P{si} = P-cell ({r},{c})")

# Now try DOWN on P1 and P2 to see if they change
print("\nTrying DOWN on P1:")
action(['LEFT'])  # Move to P1

p1_before = get_p_symbol(current_frame.ascii.split('\n'), 1)
action(['DOWN'])
p1_after_down = get_p_symbol(current_frame.ascii.split('\n'), 1)
print(f"  P1 before DOWN: {p1_before}")
print(f"  P1 after DOWN:  {p1_after_down}")
print(f"  Changed: {p1_before != p1_after_down}")

# Try UP from here
action(['UP'])
p1_after_up = get_p_symbol(current_frame.ascii.split('\n'), 1)
print(f"  P1 after UP:    {p1_after_up}")
print(f"  Changed from before: {p1_before != p1_after_up}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
